description: This file defines interfaces and classes for key-value storage implementations, including local storage, in-memory, and IndexedDB, with methods for get, set, delete, and batch operations.

classes.name: LocalStorageKVStore
classes.description: Implements key-value store using browser's local storage via Config utility.

classes.name: MemoryKVStore
classes.description: In-memory implementation of key-value store with internal storage object.

classes.name: IndexedDBKVStore
classes.description: Implements key-value store using IndexedDB with support for various transaction modes and cursor iteration.

methods.name: promisifyIDBRequest
methods.description: Converts IDBRequest or IDBTransaction events into a Promise for easier async handling.
